author: Spoookeh
body: Recently, I have noticed lots of discussions getting locked on the forums that aren't really that bad and what I thought was ok. I would just like some guidance as to what people can post and where. Such as, am I allowed to create a post in the off topic  about how I recently reached a new prestige  or something like that. Thanks for reading.

title: Rules of topics on the forums?

replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body: I know you're not allowed to make posts regarding temporary personal updates, such as "I'll be gone for a week" or something of the sorts, and you're not allowed to make posts that pertain to only one person. I think those are the two biggies :p

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body: Threads that revolve around a single person or a group of people are prohibited. This also means prestige threads are not allowed. The off-topic subcategory is for discussions not related to Avicus at all, but something that everyone could still take part in. Threads under the Avicus subcategory should relate directly to the server. Basically, if it's irrelevant to Avicus, it goes under off-topic.
